tasks.title: ui/candlestick_item.py — add the pure `capped_body_half_width` helper and cap `_draw_candles` at the pitch (S13/S14)
tasks.description: Add a module-level pure `capped_body_half_width(median_diff, base_half_width, px_per_sec, floor_px=4.0)` implementing `min(max(base_half_width, floor_px/2/px_per_sec), median_diff/2)`; `_draw_candles` calls it in place of the unconditional `min_w` clamp, and `set_data` gains an optional `pitch` used when `_width_override` is set.

AC2 — AC-D7.1 (revised) — Given a rendered `CandlestickItem` at any bar density, Then the inter-bar gap `pitch - body >= 0` always and `> 0` whenever `pitch > F` (a zero gap is acceptable only at `pitch <= F`), and the wick remains a cosmetic 1-device-px line (the D6 wick clause is unchanged).
